project: UI Session Scope Context (U2 Recovery v2)
description: Recovery implementation of dashboard session scope context (U2): project Zustand tab selection into SessionScope at the dashboard shell so factory, export, submit-work, import, and stream hooks share useDashboardSession() instead of scattering dashboardSessionStore access. Retriggers after work-plan-85 failed; baseline spec at tasks/prd-ui-session-scope-context.md.

context.customerAsk: Retrigger U2 (UI session scope context) after work-plan-85 failed on ui-session-scope-context-recovery. Deliver the session-scope seam from tasks/prd-ui-session-scope-context.md so dashboard features share one normalized session identity and API path surface.
context.problem: Dashboard features read useDashboardSessionStore directly or duplicate sessionID and path normalization, so tab switches and pause state are easy to wire incorrectly across factory saves, export, submit-work, import, prompt templates, and the live event stream.
context.solution: Keep dashboardSessionStore for selection and pause; project it through buildSessionScope and DashboardSessionProvider at the dashboard shell; migrate high-traffic hooks to useDashboardSession(); pin sessions in tests with DashboardSessionTestProvider; enforce store import boundaries with Biome and documentation; prove session-switch behavior with focused UI regression.

acceptanceCriteria: buildSessionScope is the single normalization point for sessionID, isDefault, factoryPath, workPath, eventsPath, and isPaused aligned with session-routing.ts
DashboardScreen wraps dashboard content in DashboardSessionProvider and useDashboardSession throws clearly outside the provider
High-traffic hooks (factory definition/document/save, export, submit-work, dashboard snapshot/stream) use useDashboardSession in production without importing dashboardSessionStore
Bento and import flows use session identity from scope consistent with factory saves; session tabs continue to mutate the store and refresh scope for children
DashboardSessionTestProvider and renderApp/renderWithDashboardSessionTest pin session scope for tests and Storybook
Biome noRestrictedImports and dashboard-session-scope-import-boundaries.md block store imports outside the documented allowlist
Session-switch regression (App.session-switching.stories.tsx or equivalent) proves tab changes retarget session-scoped behavior
Typecheck, lint, and targeted UI tests pass for all touched areas

userStories.title: Session scope contract and pure builder
userStories.description: As a feature developer, I want a typed SessionScope and pure buildSessionScope helper so session normalization and API paths are defined once.
acceptanceCriteria: ui/src/api/session-scope.ts exports SessionScope with sessionID, rawSessionID, isDefault, factoryPath, workPath, eventsPath, and isPaused

buildSessionScope maps null, empty, and ~default to the default session, encodes non-default paths per session-routing.ts, and sets isPaused only for the active raw session when listed in pausedSessionIDs
session-scope.test.ts covers default, encoded non-default, and pause cases
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
